description: This file defines the FooTable.Paging component, which adds pagination controls to a table, including UI creation, navigation, and event handling.

classes.name: F.Paging
classes.description: A component that manages pagination UI and logic for FooTable, including page navigation, link creation, and event handling.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Initializes the paging component, setting default options and state based on the table object.

methods.name: preinit
methods.description: Checks and applies configuration options before UI creation, including enabling/disabling the component and setting parameters.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Begins the component setup by generating the UI.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the paging UI and cleans up the component.

methods.name: predraw
methods.description: Prepares the data for paging by slicing the rows array to show only current page rows.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Updates the pagination UI based on current state, creating or removing UI elements as needed.

methods.name: $create
methods.description: Creates the pagination UI elements, including page links and container elements.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates a formatted string with current paging info, replacing placeholders with actual values.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Navigates to the first page.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Navigates to the previous page.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Navigates to the next page.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Navigates to the last page.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates to a specified page number.

methods.name: prevPages
methods.description: Shows previous set of page links based on limit.

methods.name: nextPages
methods.description: Shows next set of page links based on limit.

methods.name: pageSize
methods.description: Gets or sets the number of rows per page.

methods.name: _set
methods.description: Handles the logic for changing to a specific page, including event raising.

methods.name: _createLinks
methods.description: Generates the page navigation links based on total pages and current state.

methods.name: _setNavigation
methods.description: Updates the enabled/disabled state of navigation links.

methods.name: _setVisible
methods.description: Controls which page links are visible based on current page and limit.

methods.name: _onPageClicked
methods.description: Handles click events on pagination links, triggering navigation.
